title: Legacy of Rust
description: Legacy of Rust is a 16-map Doom II expansion set across the UAC's ruined base in a remote region of Hell known as New Eden. Divided into two eight-map episodes, the expansion features six new enemies, two new weapons, and textures based on cut content, accompanied by an all-new soundtrack.
notes: Imported from an owned GOG release of Doom + Doom II (id1.wad). [DoomWiki](https://doomwiki.org/wiki/Legacy_of_Rust)
